newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco Chicago gasoline steady on outages.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco Chicago gasoline steady on outages.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline prices were steady late Tuesday after surging higher in recent days on refiner buying, traders said.
Traders said Amoco trimmed output from a 120,000 barrel per day fluid catalytic cracker to 80,000 barrels per day for two weeks at its 410,000 barrel per day Whiting, Ind., refinery.

Traders said Citgo also was in the market seeking prompt barrels over the past two days following an outage at the 265,000 barrel per day Lyondell/Citgo Refining Co refinery near Houston. Details of the outage were not immediately available.
An Amoco spokeswoman, citing company policy, declined comment on the operating status of the Whiting refinery, a major producer in the Chicago market.
Chicago unleaded was bid even with the print after moving two cents a gallon higher this week. Premium was steady at 1.25 cents over regular unleaded.
Group Three unleaded was unchanged at 3.0/2.75 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded, with premium 1.75 cents higher.
Chicago low sulphur diesel for January deliveries eased to bids 6.0 cents a gallon under the print, with high sulphur 7.25 cents a gallon under, traders said.
Group Three diesel differentials were steady, with los sulphur bid 4.25 cents under the print and high sulphur bid 6.75 cents under, traders said.
